messages:
alex (AE): Heads-up: Horizon Labs onboarding caused a massive ingestion/usage spike. They're asking for a one-time credit + temporary custom pricing while we finish their optimization work. Need deal desk ok to move to customer-facing communication.

sam (RevOps): Can you paste the numbers and the ask? also link to the opportunity page pls.

alex (AE): Sure — current month overage = $64,812 (system shows `INV-2026-7089` pending). Horizon signed Dedicated pilot (contract `DED-CT-439`, monthly commit $28k). They're asking: 1) immediate one-time credit of $55k to cover this month 2) 60-day temporary price tier at 25% off committed rate while infra tuning finishes. ACV of full contract if converted = ~$420k. Deal link: <https://redwood.app/deals/DR-2026|DR-2026>.

maya (Finance): Quick questions: Is this a recurring concession or a true one-time hardship? How did onboarding cause the spike vs. normal usage? Need GL for credit and suggested amortization approach if we approve.

alex (AE): It's one-time operational spike — they pushed a historic dataset through for migration. We've committed infra optimizations (pipeline batching, KV caching) that should reduce runrate. Customer ops committed to follow tuning plan with eng.

jenn a (Legal): tagging in case contract amendment needed. If we provide temporary custom pricing we need an addendum: start/end date, KPIs (max spend/ingestion), rollback clause. Also need to confirm data residency/SLA remain same.

ops-billing: Billing note — INV-2026-7089 currently due. We can apply a credit memo if finance approves; will require accounting code and memo text. Applying credit will change AR aging.

maya (Finance): Proposed path: approve one-time credit up to $55k as a customer satisfaction/retention concession (non-recurring), record as contra-revenue code 708-CR, and require a signed addendum for the 60-day 25% discount that clearly states the end date and performance milestones. We'll amortize the credit over the next invoice cycle for internal revenue recognition cleanup.

deal-bot: Deal Request DR-2026 created by alex. Severity: medium. Requires finance + legal approval.

sam (RevOps): Sounds reasonable. Any precedent amounts similar? helps if we note prior exceptions.

maya (Finance): We had a similar one with Nimbus last year, credit was $40k and was approved for retention. This is larger but comparable given ACV. Recommend we cap credit at $55k conditional on the signed addendum and an engineering acceptance sign-off that tuning happened.

nate (Finance Director): I approve the one-time credit up to $55k and the 60-day 25% temporary tier under the conditions maya listed (addendum + eng sign-off + Ops billing memo). Please surface the signed addendum back into this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

alex (AE): Thanks nate — will draft addendum with jenna and loop eng for sign-off. Ops-billing, hold off on credit memo until I post signed doc.

ops-billing: Copy — will not create credit memo until we have the signed addendum and finance confirmation. I'll flag AR once posted.

jenn a (Legal): I'll start the addendum draft and ping alex for the customer redlines. Will include explicit termination date and rollback to standard rates.

alex (AE): ETA: signed by EOD Friday if no redlines. I'll update DR-2026 with the addendum and upload `ADD-2026-HZ.json` to the deal page.

maya (Finance): Once signed, I'll issue a journal entry template and send GL info to ops-billing.

nate (Finance Director): Approved in thread. Please keep the notes concise in the deal page for any future audit.

alex (AE): Will do. Thanks all.

(automated) deal-bot: DR-2026 status updated -> awaiting legal addendum.
